name: Learning Complete
name_jp: ラーニング・コンプリート
effects:
Fifteen single attacks, grants Awoken Learning Mode, Cap Break Level 1, Quad Element Mode II, Critical Damage +50% & Learning Complete to user
Awoken Learning Mode: Unlimited Fire/Water/Wind/Earth Hones, Fire/Water/Wind/Earth Rank Quick Cast & Dualcast Fire/Water/Wind/Earth
Quad Element Mode II: En-Fire, En-Water, En-Wind or En-Earth Stack
Learning Complete: After using Fire/Water/Wind/Earth abilities, cycles [DEF & RES -50% (?s)] to all enemiies > 2000 heal to party > [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to party
